summary.text: Chaunté Gilmore is the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 100 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Marilyn Stark.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a director of rehabilitation and licensed physical therapist assistant.

paragraphs.text: Chaunté Gilmore earned a high school diploma from Putnam City High School and a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma State University in 2005.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a product of Oklahoma's public schools and holds a master's degree in healthcare administration.
Her career experience includes working as a director and as a physical therapist assistant.
Gilmore said she leads a team of healthcare professionals who care for patients and seniors.
She listed accessibility to constituents, the cost of living, public schools, healthcare access, good-paying jobs and seniors among the issues she wants to work on.
